selection_scope: First documented numbered following/overtaking scenario; suggestion only. No interval or actor pair selected and no payload outcomes inspected. Freeze exact selector before acquisition.
example: For a two-second following interval, provide the identified ego front and lead rear geometry and motion on a documented clock, together with error and between-sample motion evidence. A centimetre-accuracy caption is insufficient.
fields: Source archive digest, extraction procedure/version, original record offsets and hashes; no inferred successful selection.
Two stable actor IDs and timestamps, clock units/domain, position/orientation units and coordinate/reference-point conventions.
Numeric poses, kinematics and validity/solution flags; separate missing, sensor-invalid and out-of-scope values.
Measured body supports or compact footprint vertices, ego/target INS-to-body transforms, mounting configuration and geometry/registration uncertainty.
Pose uncertainty semantics and applicable calibration records; preserve temporal and cross-vehicle dependence.
Residual clock bias/drift/jitter and corrections for the exact exported messages; no assumption of synchronous object lists.
A justified intersample motion envelope over the selected horizon, including edges/dropouts, or a separately specified statistical whole-path model.
Terms for retaining and, if intended, distributing this exact form of extract; no image, raw sensor or personal-data payload required.
stop_rule: Do not run or label a physical clearance benchmark until the exact intended deterministic or statistical contract is qualified. More download budget alone would not close the scientific gaps.
alternative_public_lead: ViF-GTAD v2 (Zenodo 7808255) documents added vehicle dimensions but its listed archive is about 6.7 GB; discovery only here, not retained evidence or an admitted source.
next_work: Seek an existing public compact numeric export plus calibration/clock records; otherwise qualify a separate public source. Do not widen the monitor or rerun closed cases to replace missing evidence.
